source_caption:
Snowfall is set in Los Angeles during the early 1980s and follows Franklin Saint, an ambitious young man whose life changes when he becomes involved in the emerging crack cocaine trade. As Franklin builds a powerful drug empire, his choices become intertwined with those of a CIA operative, a Mexican wrestler-turned-enforcer, and a crime family, revealing how the drug epidemic transforms countless lives.

In Snowfall, the story blends crime, drama, and historical fiction while exploring themes of ambition, power, family, corruption, and the devastating social impact of the crack cocaine epidemic. Created by John Singleton, Eric Amadio, and Dave Andron, the series stars Damson Idris and is praised for its compelling performances, gripping storytelling, and realistic portrayal of a pivotal era in American history.
